title: Newman--Penrose formalism in $3$-dimensional trans-Sasakian manifolds
summary: We study $3$-dimensional trans-Sasakian manifolds using the Newman--Penrose formalism. In this framework, the geometry of the structure vector field is encoded by scalar spin coefficients: acceleration, shear, expansion, and twist. A central observation is that, in dimension $3$, the trans-Sasakian condition is equivalent to the characteristic vector field defining a shear-free geodesic congruence, or equivalently a conformal foliation by geodesics.
